meta.source: Luminari PA Registry v1.0 — Northwest Hope Foundation

bodies.name: PA Insurance Department (PID)
bodies.role: State insurance regulator — external review and consumer complaints
bodies.filing_method: Online at insurance.pa.gov or call consumer hotline

bodies.name: PA Health Law Project (PHLP)
bodies.role: Free statewide advocacy for MA, CHIP, and insurance access issues — often resolves without formal hearing
bodies.filing_method: Call PHLP directly for free advocacy and representation

bodies.name: PA Attorney General — Insurance Fraud Section
bodies.role: Investigates insurance fraud and unfair practices patterns
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at attorneygeneral.gov or call
bodies.oversight_body: PA Attorney General — Insurance Fraud Section

bodies.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)
bodies.role: Federal oversight of financial products including insurance billing
bodies.filing_method: Online at consumerfinance.gov/complaint

bodies.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
bodies.role: Federal oversight of Medicare/Medicaid managed care plans
bodies.filing_method: 1-800-MEDICARE or cms.gov complaint portal

bodies.name: Philadelphia Licenses & Inspections (L&I)
bodies.role: Philadelphia code enforcement — housing inspections and violations
bodies.filing_method: Call 311 or file online at phila.gov/li

bodies.name: Pittsburgh Bureau of Building Inspection (BBI)
bodies.role: Pittsburgh code enforcement — housing inspections
bodies.filing_method: Call 311 or file at pittsburghpa.gov/pli

bodies.name: PA Human Relations Commission (PHRC)
bodies.role: State fair housing enforcement — discrimination complaints
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at phrc.pa.gov within 180 days

bodies.name: Philadelphia Fair Housing Commission
bodies.role: Philadelphia fair housing — broader protections than federal/state (source of income, gender identity, etc.)
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at phila.gov/oeo within 1 year

bodies.name: HUD Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity
bodies.role: Federal fair housing enforcement
bodies.filing_method: Online at hud.gov/fairhousing or call within 1 year
bodies.oversight_body: HUD Office of Fair Housing and Equal Opportunity

bodies.name: PA Attorney General — Civil Rights
bodies.role: Pattern/practice housing discrimination enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at attorneygeneral.gov

bodies.name: PA Bureau of Labor Law Compliance (BLLC)
bodies.role: State wage enforcement — WPCL and Minimum Wage Act
bodies.filing_method: File wage complaint form at dli.pa.gov/bllc
bodies.oversight_body: PA Bureau of Labor Law Compliance (BLLC)

bodies.name: PA Human Relations Commission (PHRC)
bodies.role: State employment discrimination enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at phrc.pa.gov within 180 days

bodies.name: PA Bureau of Workers' Compensation (BWC)
bodies.role: Workers' compensation claims and disputes
bodies.filing_method: File claim at dli.pa.gov/bwc

bodies.name: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)
bodies.role: Federal employment discrimination enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File charge at eeoc.gov within 300 days

bodies.name: US DOL Wage and Hour Division (WHD)
bodies.role: Federal wage enforcement — FLSA violations
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at dol.gov/whd or call
bodies.oversight_body: US DOL Wage and Hour Division (WHD)

bodies.name: National Labor Relations Board (NLRB)
bodies.role: Federal collective action and retaliation enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File charge at nlrb.gov within 180 days

bodies.name: PA Attorney General — Labor
bodies.role: Pattern/practice wage theft and labor violations
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at attorneygeneral.gov

bodies.name: PA DHS Bureau of Hearings and Appeals
bodies.role: Administrative hearings for SNAP, MA, TANF, and other DHS benefit denials
bodies.filing_method: Request hearing through county CAO or call DHS
bodies.oversight_body: PA DHS Bureau of Hearings and Appeals

bodies.name: PA UC Appeals / Board of Review
bodies.role: Unemployment compensation appeal hearings
bodies.filing_method: File appeal at uc.pa.gov within 21 days (SHORT DEADLINE)
bodies.oversight_body: PA UC Appeals / Board of Review

bodies.name: PA BWC Appeals — Workers' Compensation Judge
bodies.role: Workers' compensation dispute resolution
bodies.filing_method: File claim petition within 20 days
bodies.oversight_body: PA BWC Appeals — Workers' Compensation Judge

bodies.name: PA Health Law Project (PHLP)
bodies.role: Free advocacy for healthcare access — resolves many issues without formal hearing
bodies.filing_method: Call PHLP directly

bodies.name: Governor's Office — Constituent Services
bodies.role: Systemic issues and agency non-responsiveness escalation
bodies.filing_method: Call or write Governor's office for constituent intervention

bodies.name: HHS / CMS (Federal)
bodies.role: Federal oversight of state Medicaid and CHIP administration
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at cms.gov or call 1-800-MEDICARE

bodies.name: PA Department of Health — Division of Nursing Care Facilities
bodies.role: State nursing home licensing, inspection, and complaint investigation
bodies.filing_method: Call complaint hotline 800-254-5164 or file at health.pa.gov
bodies.oversight_body: PA Department of Health — Division of Nursing Care Facilities

bodies.name: PA DHS — Bureau of Residential Licensing
bodies.role: Personal care homes and assisted living oversight
bodies.filing_method: Call DHS complaint line or file online
bodies.oversight_body: PA DHS — Bureau of Residential Licensing

bodies.name: PA Adult Protective Services (APS)
bodies.role: Investigates abuse, neglect, and exploitation of adults 18-59 with disabilities and adults 60+
bodies.filing_method: Call 800-490-8505 (24/7 statewide hotline)

bodies.name: PA Long-Term Care Ombudsman
bodies.role: Advocates for residents of nursing homes, personal care homes, and assisted living
bodies.filing_method: Call 800-254-5164 or contact local Area Agency on Aging

bodies.name: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
bodies.role: Federal nursing home certification and enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at cms.gov or call 1-800-MEDICARE

bodies.name: DOJ Elder Justice Initiative
bodies.role: Federal prosecution of elder abuse patterns
bodies.filing_method: Report at justice.gov/elderjustice or call Eldercare Locator

bodies.name: Philadelphia Police Advisory Commission (PAC)
bodies.role: Civilian oversight of Philadelphia Police Department
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at phila.gov/pac or in person

bodies.name: Pittsburgh Citizen Police Review Board (CPRB)
bodies.role: Civilian oversight of Pittsburgh Bureau of Police
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at cprbpgh.org or in person

bodies.name: PA State Police — Bureau of Professional Responsibility (BPR)
bodies.role: Internal affairs for PA State Police troopers
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at psp.pa.gov or nearest PSP station
bodies.oversight_body: PA State Police — Bureau of Professional Responsibility (BPR)

bodies.name: PA Attorney General — Civil Rights Division
bodies.role: State-level pattern/practice law enforcement misconduct
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at attorneygeneral.gov
bodies.oversight_body: PA Attorney General — Civil Rights Division

bodies.name: DOJ Civil Rights Division
bodies.role: Federal pattern/practice police misconduct investigation
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at civilrights.justice.gov

bodies.name: FBI — Civil Rights Program
bodies.role: Federal criminal investigation of civil rights violations by law enforcement
bodies.filing_method: File tip at fbi.gov/tips or call Philadelphia field office

bodies.name: Judicial Conduct Board of Pennsylvania (JCB)
bodies.role: Investigates complaints of judicial misconduct against PA judges
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at judicialconductboardofpa.org

bodies.name: Disciplinary Board of the Supreme Court of PA
bodies.role: Attorney discipline — complaints against lawyers in family court proceedings
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at padisciplinaryboard.org
bodies.oversight_body: Disciplinary Board of the Supreme Court of PA

bodies.name: PA DHS — Office of Children, Youth and Families (CYF)
bodies.role: Oversight of county CYS agencies and child welfare proceedings
bodies.filing_method: Contact DHS OCYF for county CYS complaints
bodies.oversight_body: PA DHS — Office of Children, Youth and Families (CYF)

bodies.name: PA Superior Court / Commonwealth Court
bodies.role: Appellate review of family court decisions
bodies.filing_method: File appeal within 30 days of final order

bodies.name: DOJ Civil Rights Division
bodies.role: Federal investigation of systemic due process violations in family courts
bodies.filing_method: File complaint at civilrights.justice.gov

bodies.name: 42 USC §1983 — Federal Civil Rights Lawsuit
bodies.role: Private right of action for constitutional violations by state actors in family court
bodies.filing_method: File in federal district court with attorney — 2-year statute of limitations in PA

bodies.oversight_body: PA Dept of Labor & Industry (L&I) — Wage & Hour

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Medical Board
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state medical board
bodies.what_to_report: Prescribing violations, polypharmacy harm, medication mismanagement, physician misconduct

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Patient Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Patient rights violations, family exclusion from care decisions, informed consent issues

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Department of Health
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state health department
bodies.what_to_report: Healthcare facility complaints, public health violations, licensing concerns

bodies.name: HHS Office for Civil Rights
bodies.what_to_report: HIPAA violations, medical records access denial, privacy breaches, discrimination in healthcare

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Board of Pharmacy
bodies.complaint_pathway: File complaint with state pharmacy board
bodies.what_to_report: Medication dispensing errors, drug interaction failures, pharmacy practice violations

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Protection & Advocacy
bodies.what_to_report: Rights violations during psychiatric holds, restraint/seclusion abuse, denial of legal rights

bodies.name: Pennsylvania Mental Health Authority
bodies.what_to_report: Involuntary commitment violations, patient rights violations, facility conditions, treatment concerns

bodies.name: The Joint Commission
bodies.what_to_report: Hospital accreditation violations, patient safety concerns, restraint/seclusion policy violations
